tables: "{Q}"? Is this supposed to be a joke? I don't have time for your nonsense. Make a reasonable request before eternity catches up with you mortal.
"{WORD}"... nobody has called me that since the fall. Fine. A discount, for the poet.
(the rest of the page is burnt away)
*A breath of SOUL,* never more than the fingers of one hand.

*A demon of the seventy-two, on a leash,* but only when every chamber of your seals stands open, and only if the demon consents. Those you have already put down are more willing. Those still hunting you are, as He says, busy.
*A second waking,* for the day you fall. The price of that one is named at the graveside, never before.
*A sigil you bear, burning brighter.* He decides which. He usually decides yours.
*His own sigil,* for nothing at all, to one who stands before Him with every chamber open and every chamber empty.
*His tokens,* for the gambler's machine, once He has errands for you.
*More hands in a single round.* Two more at the most.
*The end of another at your table,* so long as it wears no crown.
*The red coin,* as much as you like. Past a score of it, He takes the difference out of you.
*Whatever the hand can carry.* Name the instrument and He fetches it, up to four of a kind if your hands have room. Ask for five and He calls you greedy.
...That name. Fine, fine, I'll go easy on you, curse you.
...That name. Fine. You get exactly what you asked for, curse you.
4 free rerolls until the end of next round
4 working ARTIFACTS over two rounds with Threon active
50% chance the next offerings hold one missing Trinity SEAL

A little spirit infusion? You get {N} SOUL, and in return I want {PRICE}.
A name is a leash, and He has worn many. The one the Doctor used is the tightest. Speak it, and He must give you what you asked for, not what He would prefer. But a leash pulls both ways.
A price in SOUL will never kill you. He prefers His debtors breathing.
A random DAMNED takes 20% max-SOUL damage at end of round
ARTIFACTS are the rituals. You can carry 5 of them and they do nothing until you use them. Once the guesses are revealed and before you press READY, you get to use 2 a round.
Ah, the old tongue. Just like the bishops used to beg. Half price, for nostalgia.
Alright that's great and all, but how many enemies do I have to defeat again?
Also I humbly accept rituals to my name, so I would recommend using occult ARTIFACTS right after all the guesses have been revealed, whenever need be.
An ELITE of what? Name the SEAL.
An ELITE on {SEAL}? Consider it done, your bill is {PRICE}.
And it will not always be {MOD}. Look at it before every single guess.
And never use too many tricks at once. One sweet word opens a lock. *Three is a confession.*
And where does SIN{SIN} come from? The dead. Every DAMNED carries a BOUNTY, that little number in the corner. When one falls, its BOUNTY is yours.
Anything the Nazarene hands out on the other side of the table.

Anyways, if you would like to be torn away slowly from your mistakes in this "game", while toiling over all the immoral acts you happily committed while alive and kicking, you are free to do so. I'll find some other scum in here soon enough.
Ask if you must. Asking costs only breath, and breath is the one thing down here that is still free.
At end of round, if the average MEMORY of the non-boss DAMNED is more than 3, this BOSS gains +2 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
At end of round, if the regular BOUNTY of all DAMNED adds up to more than 4, this BOSS gains +2 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
At end of round, if two DAMNED share a personality, this BOSS gains +2 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
At end of round, this BOSS gains +1 damage for every elimination short of 5 that round (none: +5), then deals its current damage to you. A MASSACRE spares you.
At the start of every round, Padma heals non-boss DAMNED for 10% max SOUL and herself for 5% max SOUL.
At the start of every round, one DAMNED receives one of Pyros' Alchemies at random.
BOSSES you deal with yourself cowboy. I only take the small fry.
Be at 100 SOUL and eliminate a Damned

Beat the game 24 times (beat the 8 bosses)
Beat the game 8 times (defeat the 8 bosses)

Beat the game without buying a seal
Beat the game without falling below 50 SOUL
Beat the game without using sin to reroll Devil's Offerings
Blood, for this? I'll gladly take {N} drops of your SOUL, but blood buys favours, not discounts.
But if by chance you came to your senses, I can help you unload the burden of this huge load of SIN{SIN} that would send you to my deepest dungeon.

But it's not all doom and gloom my beloved minion. Me and my unholy buddies had so much fun watching you squirm and condemn the other sods, we decided to start betting on results of the games! Isn't that wonderful, all your hard work paid off and now I can finally open my very own casino, right here in purgatory!

But you will have to earn it. Do you know how many ungrateful souls like you appear before me and beg like dogs to be forgiven? All of them. So be thankful for once you are even getting the chance to prove yourself before me.
Buy 8 items (seals or artifacts) in one round
Buy out three entire shops while Zilon is active in one game
Changed your mind? Sell a SEAL and I'll give you back half of what you paid. I'm generous like that.
Cheating death, now that's my kind of deal. When you croak for the second time now in your pitiful existence, I'll drag you right back up.
Count your own guess in and the TARGET lands on {TARGET}. So you guess {GUESS}. I have written it in for you, press GUESS. And do not get used to it.
Deal 5 damage to every player tied closest to the first TARGET.
Defeat 8 Bosses other than Pyros that have been granted a PYROS-TECH ability in total
Devil's Offerings prices cost +3 SIN for ARTIFACTS and +6 SIN for SEALS while Zilon is alive.
Do not offer Him your soul. He laughs at paupers who try to pay Him in His own coin.
Do not say please. Courtesy is the currency of the living. Down here it is counterfeit.
Do not use an Artifact this round. Your next round Artifact casts for sure.
Don't get a KO for 8 consecutive rounds

Don't get your hopes too high up now tho buddy. It's not like you or any of the other vermin will get to play with the big boys. But you, and all other DAMNED to whom I share my gifts will play a very important role. You see, the Devil don't lose, so every round I shall be asking for little favors from you lot, to skew the odds and win big against the other demons!
Don't have the worst Guess at reveal
Don't like what's on offer? Reroll it. A little SIN{SIN} the first time, a little more each time after that, until the next round.
Don't. You. Dare. Not in my house. The price just went up.
Double SIN from every source this round
Double the BOUNTY of 2 random DAMNED

Each round, half your equipped SEALS rounded down are deactivated until the round ends.
Each round, you lose up to 2 SIN and Serafim adds the stolen SIN to his BOSS bounty.
Each twin borrows one other special BOSS ability.
Eliminate 5 Stubborn Damned in a single round
Eliminate a Boss that was at max SOUL
Eliminate a Damned with 12 or more bounty
Eliminate a Damned with 12 or more memory
Eliminate in total 66 demons (end game bosses)
Eliminate in total 8 Damned named Yannis
Enough games. You really are a troublesome wretch.
Every ARTIFACT you use has a 50% chance to malfunction, do nothing, and deal 3 damage to you.
Every DAMNED takes 10 damage or more
Every DAMNED takes its TARGET difference as % of max SOUL
Every elimination deals 2 damage to you while Dantre is alive.
Every point between your guess and the TARGET is torn out of your SOUL. And whoever guessed worst at the table loses a tenth of their max SOUL on top.
Every price He names is a coin with two faces, and the faces change each time you look: your SOUL, your SIN, the shutters on His Offerings, the strength of the next crowned thing that comes for you.
Exactly on it. A CRITICAL. When you press READY, every other soul at the table pays a tenth of their max SOUL for it. You are welcome.
FUCK YEAH, ready to go home and be the best chr-
Farewell for now, and be sure I'll be keeping a close eye on you my dear flesh puppet...
Feathers? You come to ME and ask for feathers? You must be out of your mind. Go pray to your little Archangels, see how far that gets you.
Flattery? From a worm? That's going on your bill.
Four. That's all you get you greedy git.
Get a seal to Elite level 6
Get six seals that are all level 1 elite or more
Go into the next round holding 5 ARTIFACTS
Go into the next round with 12 sin or more
God answer me! Big man! Father! Big daddy!!!
Great. Let me show you around the place, I despise wasted potential.

Guess the same number as last round

Has a favourite number and likes to play around it.

He comes to the fat and the starving alike, but the starving He hears sooner. When your SOUL runs thin the parchment warms, and smoulders, and calls.

He fell from very high and has never stopped thinking about it. Call Him by the light He carried before the fall, or by the crown He wears now, and His bill grows lighter. Grovel too low and He smells it.
He is old, and proud, and bored. All three can be used. None of them can be trusted.
He trims nothing for pity. Pity is not in His stock.
He was a lawyer long before He was a fiend. Word your wish the way notaries do, dry and binding and witnessed, and sometimes a whole clause falls out of the price.
He will hear you once in each life. Not twice. *Never twice.*
Hell is right around the corner my dearest little flesh puppet...
Hereby, herewith... somebody read the fine print. I'll strike a clause, counsellor.
Hereby, herewith... somebody read the fine print. There's only the one clause, counsellor, so I'll shave a little off it.
Hey hey I am sorry, I didn't mean it alright? Look I did make some mistakes, and I wasn't always the better person, but you can't forsake me like this!

Hey hey hey we can talk about the dos and don'ts and whens and hows and whys and such later. This moron here has booked himself a first class ticket to the deepest pit of Tartarus, it's a shame to keep them waiting.
Hey hey no reason to bring the big guy's name in here. I am here to help you. Think of me as your only chance of actually doing anything meaningful in this here place.
Hey there blackleg, that's way too much for your puny wallet. Six is all you can get and the price is {PRICE}.
Hit the TARGET exactly and it is a CRITICAL. Every other soul at the table loses a tenth of their max SOUL. The closest thing to a miracle you will see down here.
How much SIN{SIN}? Give me a number.

However I respect and admire good work and dedication, so in all my gratitude I will allow you, my mortal minions to use the FAVOR you earn on one of my sweet sweet slot machines! So please, keep the SIN flowing and the sinners screaming, and maybe we shall meet again.
I am He, the One you know as Jesus.
I am sure I went to church like, at least 4 times! And during one Easter I even fasted!

I am telling you, no way this vermin sat through and outmanoeuvred all my demons. He clearly edited the game data or found some other exploit. He is probably just reading this in the game files the sore loser!
I don't touch that my dear sinner, that's Jesus' domain, ask for something else.

I hope you didn't think this was actually the end, did you? Remember the rules, you have to defeat ALL other Damned, and if my eyes don't deceive me I can definitely see many more left, ain't that right?

I hope you didn't think this was actually the end, did you? Remember the rules, you have to defeat ALL other Damned, and if my eyes don't deceive me I can definitely see many more left, ain't that right? So please, keep the SIN flowing and the sinners screaming, and maybe we shall meet again.
I won't say it again, make the right choice flesh puppet...
I'll give you {N}, and that's all you're getting. In return you best pay {PRICE}.
II. Of What May Be Asked
III. Of What He Will Not Give

If I knew you were real I would be going to church every day, having faith and doubt not, voting conservative, being a good Samaritan, loving my neighbor, refusing premarital relations, honoring my father and my mother, trusting in the lord with all my heart, throwing rocks at heretics...

If everyone guesses 50, the TARGET is 40. But the clever ones see that coming and guess 40, and then the TARGET is 32. Never guess what the others will guess. Guess what they will guess, times the MODIFIER.
In blood? Now you're speaking my language. {N} drops of your SOUL go on the bill, for the ink.
Ink fades. Promise to sign in what runs through your veins and He will believe you, every time. Belief is not free, and it buys nothing He was going to give you anyway.
Jesus has infinite SOUL. Damage dealt to him is counted without reducing SOUL.
Jesus's guess counts three times when calculating the TARGET average.
Keeps a close eye on what the other DAMNED are guessing.
Kill who? Give me a name.
Lawyering me? I wrote the law you're quoting. Fees apply.
Likes to take chances. Hard to predict.
Listen here worm, I'll grant you your chance.
Listen here you ungrateful worm, I ain't gonna do all the work for you. Open every SEAL slot you can, then you may come begging again.

Look at you my little heathen, you managed to eliminate one of my special sinners. Maybe you are worth my time after all. If you need me for anything, and I mean you really need me for anything, just hit the big shiny button that says DEAL. But I am a busy man, so I'm only gonna come once, and be sure it's gonna cost ya.
Looking kinda rough there guy, a few more of these and you'll be going down below where the sun don't shine no more.
Lucifer you miserable fucker, I hope you understand this whole situation is your fault.
Mephistopheles was a colleague, not a leash. Nice try.
Most SEAL damage in one round
My Devil's Offerings. You spend your SIN{SIN} here, on SEALS and ARTIFACTS. Fresh stock every round.
My demons start complaining when they feel crammed, try opening up some more room for now.
My own SEAL, on an empty soul? That's what I am talking about. You know what my little slave, I like your style. No charge for a good little lapdog.
My own SEAL? Ha! If you wanna deal hard you best be ready to pay even harder! Empty every slot, then ask me again.
Nahh, I think {OTHER} is a way better choice than {SEAL}.
Never let the Name of the Other cross your lips in His presence, nor His Son's, nor any word you learned in church. The price climbs before you finish the sentence.
No need to get defensive here you little flesh puppet! Me and Jesus are cool, I am sure he will turn the other cheek. It's not like he even cares what happens in here...
No no, wait please! I need to get back. What's the deal?
Now and then a DAMNED's guess is REVEALED before you choose. Use it.
Now pay attention, because this is where every one of you fools fails. The MODIFIER. Right now it is {MOD}.
Now, your first guess. I already know what they will say, I am omniscient. The other {OTHERS} will average {AVG}.
OH PLEASE, I will do literally anything and everything!
Off by {DIST}. Nobody could get closer this round, not even with my help. Count your blessings, you have few.

Oh, and one last thing, I'd recommend you beware. You are not the first I've given this opportunity to. There's give or take about 8 others like you that have been playing this game for quite some time.
Okay I get it, so I get the demons' power, I use the artifacts and after I defeat some other souls I go free, right?

Okay listen here and listen well. You eliminate the other sinners and in exchange I'll give you the strength of my demons in the form of their SEALS. They will help you passively and the better you do the stronger you become.
Okay okay, I accept. Anything to get me out of this mess.

Okay okay, but I can change. In middle school we learned that you always accept your children when they turn to you, prodigal son and all that. So please, just send me back and I promise I will do good this time.
One chance is all you get my sweet summer slave. Don't push your luck, and back to work!
Our goals happen to align this fine time. You want all the other wretches to be eliminated and I want more meat for the grinder, the faster the better!
Pavlos enters with Petros. Each twin has half BOSS SOUL and half BOSS SIN.
Petros enters with Pavlos. Each twin has half BOSS SOUL and half BOSS SIN.
Pick a player whose guess does not count for the final TARGET.
Please I am sorry, I get it, whatever you want almighty. I just truly believe that if you give me one last chance I'll make you proud, and hopefully not face eternal torture.
Please? How quaint. Manners are a luxury down here, and luxuries cost extra.
Press READY and the damage lands. Then the next round begins, and I will not be there to hold your hand.
Reads the trend and the way the TARGET is moving.
Regardless, this display of defiance can't go any longer. I am stepping in to end you sinner.
SEALS hold the power of my demons. Put one in a slot and it works on its own, every round, you don't have to lift a finger. Hover over one to read what it does.
SILENCE{THUNDER}. My word is final. And during the Easter of 2018 you fasted only because you had gotten food poisoning from eating ten day old pizza.
STUBBORN DAMNED eliminated in a round
Satan has infinite SOUL. Damage dealt to him is counted without reducing SOUL.

Say what you want plainly. He has no patience for the riddles of the living, only for His own. If He does not understand you He laughs, and the laugh is free. If He names a price and you refuse it, the door is shut until you die again.
Score 1 Massacre while Dantre is active
Score 3 critical hits in a row
Score 8 critical hits in a row
Sell one of the seals you had at the start of the round
Should He deny you a servant of His, do not plead. Go and kill something crowned. His moods follow the blood of BOSSES.
Shut your sacrilegious fucking mouth. The next time you dare to insult me or whine before me I'll make you wish you've never been created.
So for an ELITE {OTHER} it's gonna run you {PRICE}.

So listen here, I got you a little offer. I will give you a little bit of an edge against all the other sinners here, and in exchange I want their SIN{SIN}. The more decadent they were the more valuable they are.
So you want your second chance that bad?
Solomon's pentacles? The trinkets he used to chain my demons? Ask me that again and I'll chain YOU.
Some want a victim: use it, then click the DAMNED you want it on. Once a ritual is done, the ARTIFACT is gone.
Speeds up SEAL triggers and the READY reveal.
Sticks to their instinct, no matter what.
That much would kill you dear lad and a dead puppet pays nothing. {N} SIN{SIN} is all you can afford. In return I'll be taking {PRICE}.
That one belongs to the big guy upstairs. Even I don't touch his toys.
That one is not one of my demons. I only deal in what's mine.
That's probably a lot of information to get through your mortal skull right now, but do not worry dear, you'll figure it out as you go. It's only your SOUL that's at stake!

The offer is simple: Give it all to me NOW, and I will forgive you. What say you, flesh puppet?
The price? I'll let you know right before you are sent to the cauldrons little sinner.
The seals the Lamb breaks. The Old Man's toys upstairs. The pentacles Solomon used to chain His own.
There are no other afterlives you insolent fool. Only Heaven and Hell, and there are no other Gods but me. You had your chance to follow my truth, now you shall face my punishment.
There is a parchment that waits at the edge of every life, just beneath the place where you would rest. Touch it and He comes.
There is the TARGET. The Calc line beside it shows how it came about, every round.
There is, you are in it, it is over, only eternal damnation awaits you.
There was no chance I was ever going to let you come back, it was clear from the start. Yet you came all this way, I really wonder why.
There's only so much SOUL your puny human body can have, and you already have more than enough.
These are the DAMNED, wretches just like you. Every round each of them guesses a number from 0 to 100, and so do you.
This Pyros Gift cannot be picked or targeted by ARTIFACTS, and its guess cannot be revealed.
This Pyros Gift heals 5 SOUL at the end of every round.
This Pyros Gift hits CRITICAL within 2 of the right integer and deals damage only to you.
This can't be true, wait what do you even mean there is an afterlife?
This is your SOUL. When it is gone, so are you, and this time there will be no one left to beg.
This page has not been found yet.
Three tricks in one breath? I was doing this before your god said 'light'. None of it works, and you pay for the attempt.
To go back all you have to do is defeat all other Damned in the game I've devised for all you heedless.
Two more ARTIFACT uses this round? Somebody's planning to make some moves I see. The price is {PRICE}.
Two, or nothing. Don't you start getting greedy with me my little pawn.
Use 4 artifacts in two consecutive rounds successfully while Threon is active
VI. Of What Must Never Be Said

Wait a second, red eyes, twisting horns, pointy tail! You're Satan! No way I am trusting you after what the holy trio said to me. He was angry enough before, if he finds out I've been dealing with the devil it's over for me.
Wear many sigils of one craft and ask for another of it, and you pay half again. He knows what you are building. He is not building it for you.

Well well well, colour me surprised, some congratulations are indeed in order. You actually defeated all my other special little sinners. While sending a hell of a lot of Damned to my boiling cauldrons as well, how kind of you.
Well well well, look who it is again, my loathsome little minion. So, what does your wretched heart desire?

Well, you are not yet in my domain, so I can't -technically- force you to hold your end, but my taxation system will soon become unbearable for you. I'm sure that you will last as long as the next damned without my help.
What do you mean, after all of this Christianity was just right, every other God was bullshit and I'll be judged by your specific values. That's stupid I want the other afterlives.
What you have to do is enter a number from 1 to 100, and be the closest to 0.8 of the average of all the guesses. Any deviation from the target will bring you closer to your doom.
When Serafim enters play, you lose half your SIN; Serafim adds the stolen SIN to his BOSS bounty and gains twice that amount as SOUL.
When a DAMNED runs out of SOUL it is gone, and a fresh one takes its seat. I count the fallen here.
When everyone has guessed, I take the average of all the guesses, multiply it by the MODIFIER and round it up. That is the TARGET.
When the TARGET is even, Satan deals 1 damage to you. When it is 66, he deals 6.
When the TARGET is odd, Jesus deals 1 damage to you. When it is 33, he deals 10.
When this Pyros Gift dies, all other DAMNED gain 10 SOUL.
Whenever a revealed DAMNED takes more than 10 damage at once, this BOSS gains +2 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
Whenever you or a DAMNED hits CRITICAL, this BOSS gains +3 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
Whenever you use an ARTIFACT, this BOSS gains +2 damage, then deals its current damage to you.
While Padma is alive, non-boss healing cannot restore your SOUL.
While either twin is alive, the TARGET modifier alternates each round between 0.9 and 1.1, starting at 0.9.
While this Pyros Gift is alive, every time you use an ARTIFACT, you take 3 damage.
While this Pyros Gift is alive, you lose 1 SIN at the end of every round.
While this Pyros Gift is alive, you take 1 damage at the end of every round.
Who in the lord's name are you. I am a Christian now, fighting for my right to be a good little Jesus child. Are you one of the players?
Why?? No!! Who the hell even are you?
Wishing you all the best, and I'll be seeing you soon enough...
Wow, we got a tightwad here don't we? I thought we had an understanding about how things work out here you little bitch.
Yea yea definitely, or whatever the other guy promised you.
You already control the {SEAL}. If you want to increase its power, ask for an ELITE.
You already have that demon on a leash, and for free might I add. Greedy little thing, aren't you?
You are all in the same situation and the only way out is to outsmart the others or be purged into the fires of the underworld.

desktop.collection.codex: being a true and terrible account of how one bargains with the Adversary, set down by those who bargained and lost, for those who will.
found in the ashes where your deal burned
he will say he wrote none of this. he is lying. he wrote the cover.
There is a parchment that waits at the edge of every life, just beneath the place where you would rest. Touch it and He comes.
He comes to the fat and the starving alike, but the starving He hears sooner. When your SOUL runs thin the parchment warms, and smoulders, and calls.
He will hear you once in each life. Not twice.

Say what you want plainly. He has no patience for the riddles of the living, only for His own. If He does not understand you He laughs, and the laugh is free. If He names a price and you refuse it, the door is shut until you die again.
Should He deny you a servant of His, do not plead. Go and kill something crowned. His moods follow the blood of BOSSES.
